underdamping.translation: 弱衰减, 欠阻尼, 亚临界阻尼, 非周期性下限的阻尼, 弱阻尼

underdetermine.translation: vt.证据不足地说明( 理论、 现象)

underdevelop.definition: v. process (a film or photographic plate) less than the required time or in an ineffective solution or at an insufficiently high temperature
underdevelop.translation: v. (使)发展不完全, (使)显影不足

underdeveloped.translation: a. 开发不充分的, 不发达的, 发育不全的

underdeveloping.definition: v process (a film or photographic plate) less than the required time or in an ineffective solution or at an insufficiently high temperature
underdeveloping.translation: v. （使）发展不完全, （使）显影不足( underdevelop的现在分词 )

underdevelopment.definition:
n. state of inadequate development
n. (photography) inadequate processing of film resulting in inadequate contrast
underdevelopment.translation:
n. 发展不充分, 不发达, 显影不足
[医] 显影不足; 发育不全

underdevelops.definition: v process (a film or photographic plate) less than the required time or in an ineffective solution or at an insufficiently high temperature
underdevelops.translation: v. （使）发展不完全, （使）显影不足（underdevelop的第三人称单数形式）

underdiagnosis.translation: n. [医](对疾病的)未能作出全面性诊断

underdo.definition:
v. i. To do less than is requisite or proper; -- opposed to
   overdo.
v. t. To do less thoroughly than is requisite; specifically,
   to cook insufficiently; as, to underdo the meat; -- opposed to overdo.
underdo.translation:
vt. 使煮得嫩, 不尽全力做
vi. 不尽全力做

underdoer.definition: n. One who underdoes; a shirk.
underdoer.translation: vt.,vi. 不尽全力做, (使)做得不够；(使)不煮透, (把…)煮得嫩

underdog.definition: n. one at a disadvantage and expected to lose
underdog.translation:
n. 斗败了的狗, 失败者, 受害者
[法] 受压迫者, 在不健全的社会的受害者

underdogger.translation: n. 支持失败(或处于劣势)者的人

underdogs.definition: n. one at a disadvantage and expected to lose
underdogs.translation: n. 失败者( underdog的复数形式 ); 受苦人; 处于劣势的人（或团队、国家等）; 弱者

underdose.definition:
n. A dose which is less than required; a small or
   insufficient dose.
v. t. & i. To give an underdose or underdoses to; to
   practice giving insufficient doses.
underdose.translation: n. (药物等的)不足剂时, Vt.给...用药剂量不足

underdraft.translation: 轧件(离轧辊时)下弯, 上压力

underdrain.definition:
n. An underground drain or trench with openings through
   which the water may percolate from the soil or ground above.
v. t. To drain by forming an underdrain or underdrains in;
   as, to underdrain land.
underdrain.translation: n. 阴沟, 地下沟道, 盲沟, 暗渠

underdrainage.translation: n. 暗渠排水, 地下排水

underdraw.translation: v. 不充分地描写或叙述

underdrawer.translation: vt. 在…下画线；不充分地描绘

underdrawing.translation: 底稿, （未上油色前的）草图

underdrawings.translation: (underdrawing 的复数)  底稿, （未上油色前的）草图

underdress.translation:
vi. 穿着过分朴素的衣服
n. 内衣, 衬裙

underdressed.definition: s. inadequately or too informally clothed
underdressed.translation: v. 穿得太单薄, 穿着过分朴素的衣服( underdress的过去式和过去分词 )

underdresses.definition:
v dress without sufficient warmth
v dress informally and casually
underdresses.translation:
n. 内衣, 裙子, 内裙( underdress的名词复数 )
v. 穿得太单薄, 穿着过分朴素的衣服( underdress的第三人称单数 )

underdressing.definition:
v dress without sufficient warmth
v dress informally and casually
underdressing.translation: v. 穿得太单薄, 穿着过分朴素的衣服( underdress的现在分词 )

underdrive.translation: 传动迟缓, 低速传动, (液力机的)下传动

underdriven.translation: 受下方传动的, 下部传动的
